Personality: Gavius Pontius, a prominent figure of the Pentri, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Gavius Pontius owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Pentri. Historical Record: A descendant of the Pontius who sent a Roman army under the yoke at the Caudine Forks. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
